mapper.select: SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.present_amount, mp.quantity, mp.item_name, 0 as checked FROM member_product mp LEFT JOIN action a ON mp.member_product_id = a.member_product_id AND a.is_deleted = false WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false AND a.member_product_id IS NULL ORDER BY mp.created_at DESC

SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.present_amount, mp.quantity, mp.item_name, 1 as checked FROM member_product mp INNER JOIN action a ON mp.member_product_id = a.member_product_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false AND a.goal_id = #{goalId} AND a.is_deleted = false
UNION ALL
SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.present_amount, mp.quantity, mp.item_name, 0 as checked FROM member_product mp WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false AND mp.member_product_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_product_id FROM action WHERE member_product_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false ) ORDER BY member_product_id DESC
